title: ADscan recheck result v1
description: runs/<run_id>/recheck_result.json: what one adscan recheck run decided for every item it targeted, the reads it performed and, for a walk or an exercise, where the route went. adscan recheck --json prints this document on stdout. Written by one writer (_result_document in adscan_internal/services/recheck/runner.py). Declared objects may gain fields within the major; do not reject unknown keys. Names AD objects (labels, object ids), so it is client data.

plan.$comment: The adscan.run_plan/1 document of this run (kind recheck); validate it with run_plan.v1.json. A --path target is recorded as the full path id, whatever form was typed.

recorded_at_frame.$comment: Which clock recorded_at came from (adscan_core/reporting/clock_frame.py): the host clock may be stepped to a domain controller.

credential.$comment: Which account the reads used: the workspace's own account, or the one given with --username for this run only (never stored in the workspace). Never carries a secret.

control_observations.$comment: Hardened controls the recheck's reads observed (positive evidence), kept here and never written into the scan's report.

key.$comment: The finding catalog key, or the step's relation.

object_id.$comment: The affected object (a SID, wk:<SID> or guid:<GUID>); null for a domain-level item.

check_id.$comment: The read-only check that observes the item; null when it has none in this release.

verdict_text.$comment: The verdict in words, with its reason.

reason.$comment: Why an item was not re-checked or where a walk stopped (open vocabulary, for example read_failed:credential_rejected).

not_recheckable_reason.$comment: Added within major 1 (additive, optional). The declared reason this item cannot be re-checked read-only (its detector has no read-only check, or that check never decides this key), in words; empty when that is not why it was not re-checked. verdict_text then carries the same sentence.

transition.$comment: The ledger change this run applied; empty when it applied none.

examined.$comment: Objects read for an object-scoped read; null for a domain-wide read.
